# Elizabeth Beattie "Bessie" Telfer (1871–1948)

**Role:** Daughter of the Telfer family, married into the Beaton family

Elizabeth Beattie "Bessie" Telfer was born in 1871 and died in 1948. She married into the Beaton family.

**Source:** Telfer family records
